maria: Quick thread  need a concise battlecard for this launch: 3 micro-claims (econ, reliability, ops) + two rebut snippets for sales. Keep everything <2 lines.
leo: Draft micro-claims: "Predictable unit economics, not surprise bills." "Production SLAs with carrier-grade fallbacks." "Serving-as-a-product so your infra team ships features, not firefights."
cleo: Short rebut vs cloud platforms: "Their scale is broad; their tail latency and billing can surprise. We lock performance and unit costs with reserved serving."
sam: Rebut vs infra vendors: "Building doesnt stop at deploy. We remove ongoing ops toil and provide SLOs + autoscaling out of the box."
maria: Benchmark blurb (sanitized) to include: p50 11ms Redwood-hosted vs p50 30ms public API; normalized token cost ~0.0008 vs 0.0020. Add caveat line: "Normalized to short context and steady-state batching; results vary by workload."
cleo: I'll format the 3-bullet card and two rebut scripts into the sales swipe file and upload.
deploy-bot: file uploaded: /s/battlecard-micro v1 (cleo) :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — we'll review in tomorrow's creative sync. Short, punchy, and use "predictable" language not "cheaper".
